\tikzset{

  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[fda] (0,0)--(1,0); \draw[fda] (1,0)--(2,0);
    \draw[fda] (1,0) arc[start angle=-90, end angle=270, radius=0.35];
    \node[fdx] at (0,0){}; \node[fdx] at (2,0){}; \node[fdv] at (1,0){};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (0,0){$y$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (2,0){$x$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (1,0){$z$};
    \node[fdS] at (1,-1.1) {(a) oriented tadpole, $S=1$};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=3.6cm]
    \draw[fda] (0,-0.6)--(0.6,0); \draw[fda] (0.6,0)--(0,0.6);
    \draw[fda] (2.4,-0.6)--(1.8,0); \draw[fda] (1.8,0)--(2.4,0.6);
    \draw[fda] (0.6,0) to[bend left=50] (1.8,0); \draw[fda] (1.8,0) to[bend left=50] (0.6,0);
    \foreach \p in {(0,0.6),(0,-0.6),(2.4,0.6),(2.4,-0.6)} \node[fdx] at \p {};
    \node[fdv] at (0.6,0){}; \node[fdv] at (1.8,0){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (0,0.6){$x_1$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (0,-0.6){$y_1$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (2.4,0.6){$x_2$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (2.4,-0.6){$y_2$};
    \node[fdS] at (1.2,-1.1) {(b) oriented fish, $S=1$};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=7.7cm]
    \draw[fda] (0,0)--(0.6,0); \draw[fda] (2,0)--(2.6,0);
    \draw[fda] (0.6,0)--(2,0); \draw[fda] (0.6,0) to[bend right=60] (2,0); \draw[fda] (2,0) to[bend right=60] (0.6,0);
    \node[fdx] at (0,0){}; \node[fdx] at (2.6,0){}; \node[fdv] at (0.6,0){}; \node[fdv] at (2,0){};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (0,0){$y$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (2.6,0){$x$};
    \node[fdS] at (1.3,-1.1) {(c) oriented sunset, $S=2$};
